## ✅ Completed Tasks

1. **Created a new AnimatedLoader component** (`src/components/ui/AnimatedLoader.tsx`) with:
   - Two gradient variants (gradient1 and gradient2) matching your provided SVGs
   - Three size options (sm, md, lg)
   - Customizable className prop
   - Built-in CSS animation for the dash effect

2. **Added CSS animation styles** to `src/index.css`:
   - Added the `dash` keyframe animation
   - Added `.animated-loader` utility classes
   - Proper positioning and animation timing

3. **Replaced loading animations** in key files throughout the project:
   - `src/App.tsx` - Main app loading
   - `src/components/PaymentCallbackHandler.tsx` - Payment verification loading
   - `src/pages/EmailVerification.tsx` - Email verification loading
   - `src/components/AuthenticationStatus.tsx` - Auth status loading
   - `src/components/OAuthCallback.tsx` - OAuth callback loading
   - `src/components/ui/OAuthButton.tsx` - OAuth button loading
   - `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` - Dashboard loading
   - `src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx` - Route protection loading
   - `src/pages/Auth.tsx` - Authentication form loading

## 🎨 Features of the New Loader

- **Two beautiful gradient variants**: Purple-to-teal and Red-to-green gradients
- **Smooth animation**: 1.75s ease-out infinite dash animation
- **Responsive sizing**: Small (sm), medium (md), and large (lg) sizes
- **Consistent styling**: Matches your project's design system
- **Performance optimized**: Uses CSS animations instead of JavaScript

## 🚀 Usage

You can now use the new loader anywhere in your project:

```tsx
import { AnimatedLoader } from '@/components/ui/AnimatedLoader';

// Basic usage
<AnimatedLoader />

// With size and variant
<AnimatedLoader size="lg" variant="gradient2" />

// With custom styling
<AnimatedLoader className="my-custom-class" />
```

The new animated loader provides a much more modern and visually appealing loading experience compared to the previous spinning circles and icons. The gradient colors and smooth animation create a professional, polished feel throughout your application.
